note: The plugin set of the plugins-10 baseline workload (docs/architecture/compat-vs-performance.md section 6 item 1). loading: native = the jar declares folia-supported; bridged = it does not and loads through the Aurora Bridge, which needs aurora.bridge.mode = "safe"; bundled = ships inside the server jar. jar is a machine-local path checked on 2026-10-06 or null; nothing here was downloaded and no jar is vendored. run_baseline.py does not read these paths: the operator assembles a plugins directory and passes it with --plugins-dir, and the run records each jar's SHA-256.

plugins.name: EssentialsX
plugins.note: plugin.yml name Essentials, version 2.22.1-dev+25-cfb6f12; declares no folia-supported.

plugins.name: Vault
plugins.note: MilkBowl Vault 1.7.3-b131; declares no folia-supported. Do not substitute ~/Downloads/Vault-1.7.4.jar: that is the 1.7.3-CMI fork, which declares folia-supported and would load natively, not through the bridge.

plugins.name: SuperiorSkyblock2
plugins.note: The Folia port, version 2026.3; declares folia-supported: true. Local build output, so its hash changes with every rebuild; the run's provenance records the hash actually used.

modules.name: SSB-AuroraWorlds

plugins.name: spark
